$$\frac{6^6-16(6^3)+64}{6^3-8} = \frac{46656-16(216)+64}{216-8}$$
$$= \frac{46656-3456+64}{208}$$
$$= \frac{43264}{208}$$

Now, we simplify the fraction:
$$\frac{43264}{208} = \frac{10816}{52}$$
$$= \frac{2704}{13}$$

grade.gold_answer: Note that $\left(x^3-8\right)^2=x^6-16x^3+64$. So $\frac{x^6-16x^3+64}{x^3-8}=\frac{\left(x^3-8\right)^2}{x^3-8}=x^3-8$. So, the answer is $6^3-8=216-8=\boxed{208}$.
